description: This PHP class 'ProjectCategoriesRepository' provides database access methods to retrieve project category data from a MySQL database, including fetching all records ordered by name. It extends a base 'MysqlRepository' class and uses a SQL query builder.

classes.name: ProjectCategoriesRepository
classes.description: Repository class for accessing project category data from the database, providing methods to query and retrieve categories.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all project categories from the database, ordered by name.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Constructs a base SELECT SQL query builder for project_category table, selecting all columns and ordering by name.
